newsitem.title: USA: Conn. Democrats oppose television bingo games.
newsitem.headline: Conn. Democrats oppose television bingo games.

text.p: Key Connecticut Senate Democrats said Wednesday they oppose changing the state law to allow Connecticut Lottery Corp to launch television bingo.

They spoke a day after Connecticut Attorney General Richard Blumenthal said Lottery Corp cannot introduce television bingo unless the legislature changes the law which limits the operation of bingo to certain charitable groups.

"The CLC is attempting to expand gambling, but this time through what amounts to video bingo," Senate President Pro Tempore Kevin Sullivan said. "It's a move I'm extremely uncomfortable with, and as the Senate president, not one I'm willing to support."
The quasi-public Lottery Corp had been counting on the new game to raise $20 million for the state budget in the next fiscal year.
